meta.title: Cometary Vortex – 1
meta.description: O shining planets of the Milky Way, may you last forever.

units.rawText: Jiutian sector, around Titan.
units.displayText: Jiutian sector, around Titan.

spans.text: Jiutian sector, around Titan.

units.rawText: Area C teams, cover the left flank. Area B teams, keep an eye on that dense entropic pack at 8 o'clock.
units.displayText: Area C teams, cover the left flank. Area B teams, keep an eye on that dense entropic pack at 8 o'clock.

spans.text: Area C teams, cover the left flank. Area B teams, keep an eye on that dense entropic pack at 8 o'clock.

units.rawText: Right-side sensors detecting entropics at 12 o'clock.
units.displayText: Right-side sensors detecting entropics at 12 o'clock.

spans.text: Right-side sensors detecting entropics at 12 o'clock.

units.rawText: Activate all starboard Collapsar Stream batteries! 12 o'clock, bearing 120 degrees, range 50, FIRE!
units.displayText: Activate all starboard Collapsar Stream batteries! 12 o'clock, bearing 120 degrees, range 50, FIRE!

spans.text: Activate all starboard Collapsar Stream batteries! 12 o'clock, bearing 120 degrees, range 50, FIRE!

units.rawText: The amount of entropic creatures in Titan's airspace has spiked by several times.
units.displayText: The amount of entropic creatures in Titan's airspace has spiked by several times.

spans.text: The amount of entropic creatures in Titan's airspace has spiked by several times.

units.rawText: The entropic comet might have been destroyed, but its fragments seem to have mutated into new entropics... and with their leader on Titan's surface, we can't afford to waste time here.
units.displayText: The entropic comet might have been destroyed, but its fragments seem to have mutated into new entropics... and with their leader on Titan's surface, we can't afford to waste time here.

spans.text: The entropic comet might have been destroyed, but its fragments seem to have mutated into new entropics... and with their leader on Titan's surface, we can't afford to waste time here.

units.rawText: Prepare to fire the Hellbore cannon. We'll break through the entropics blockading Titan with a high-energy shot. The Area A teams will be our vanguard; the other teams will make Titan-fall in sequence after them.
units.displayText: Prepare to fire the Hellbore cannon. We'll break through the entropics blockading Titan with a high-energy shot. The Area A teams will be our vanguard; the other teams will make Titan-fall in sequence after them.

spans.text: Prepare to fire the Hellbore cannon. We'll break through the entropics blockading Titan with a high-energy shot. The Area A teams will be our vanguard; the other teams will make Titan-fall in sequence after them.

units.rawText: Hellbore Cannon charged.
units.displayText: Hellbore Cannon charged.

spans.text: Hellbore Cannon charged.

units.rawText: <size=40>FIRE!</size>
units.displayText: FIRE!

spans.text: FIRE!

units.rawText: A high-powered beam erupts from the cannon, obliterating everything it touches. As the visual obstruction before them is cleared away, the surface of Titan is revealed to the onlookers...
units.displayText: A high-powered beam erupts from the cannon, obliterating everything it touches. As the visual obstruction before them is cleared away, the surface of Titan is revealed to the onlookers...

spans.text: A high-powered beam erupts from the cannon, obliterating everything it touches. As the visual obstruction before them is cleared away, the surface of Titan is revealed to the onlookers...

units.rawText: Titan...
units.displayText: Titan...

spans.text: Titan...

units.rawText: It's been completely entropized...
units.displayText: It's been completely entropized...

spans.text: It's been completely entropized...

units.rawText: The moon that once sparkled brightly in the night sky has been consumed by purple, becoming nothing more than a dead world.
units.displayText: The moon that once sparkled brightly in the night sky has been consumed by purple, becoming nothing more than a dead world.

spans.text: The moon that once sparkled brightly in the night sky has been consumed by purple, becoming nothing more than a dead world.

units.rawText: All squads, make Titan-fall now! LZ is Titan Base!
units.displayText: All squads, make Titan-fall now! LZ is Titan Base!

spans.text: All squads, make Titan-fall now! LZ is Titan Base!

units.rawText: <size=40>Yes ma'am!</size>
units.displayText: Yes ma'am!

spans.text: Yes ma'am!

units.rawText: One spaceship after another enters Titan's atmosphere, and countless shooting stars begin descending from the heavens, racing toward the horizon.
units.displayText: One spaceship after another enters Titan's atmosphere, and countless shooting stars begin descending from the heavens, racing toward the horizon.

spans.text: One spaceship after another enters Titan's atmosphere, and countless shooting stars begin descending from the heavens, racing toward the horizon.

units.rawText: You're here at last... What took you so long?!
units.displayText: You're here at last... What took you so long?!

spans.text: You're here at last... What took you so long?!

units.rawText: Rumble!
units.displayText: Rumble!

spans.text: Rumble!

units.rawText: Titan's crust splits open and vast quantities of purple creatures begin emerging from the ground.
units.displayText: Titan's crust splits open and vast quantities of purple creatures begin emerging from the ground.

spans.text: Titan's crust splits open and vast quantities of purple creatures begin emerging from the ground.

units.rawText: High-energy entropic reaction detected on planetary surface...
units.displayText: High-energy entropic reaction detected on planetary surface...

spans.text: High-energy entropic reaction detected on planetary surface...

units.rawText: All units, fire at will on the surface bedrock.
units.displayText: All units, fire at will on the surface bedrock.

spans.text: All units, fire at will on the surface bedrock.

units.rawText: Xuannu pulls her trigger and a scorching beam instantly liquefies the rock on Titan.
units.displayText: Xuannu pulls her trigger and a scorching beam instantly liquefies the rock on Titan.

spans.text: Xuannu pulls her trigger and a scorching beam instantly liquefies the rock on Titan.

units.rawText: <size=40>FIRE!</size>
units.displayText: FIRE!

spans.text: FIRE!

units.rawText: As the surrounding rocks are liquified, a small pack of entropics is instantly reduced to ash by the incredible heat.
units.displayText: As the surrounding rocks are liquified, a small pack of entropics is instantly reduced to ash by the incredible heat.

spans.text: As the surrounding rocks are liquified, a small pack of entropics is instantly reduced to ash by the incredible heat.

units.rawText: We meet at last, Jiutian's Administrator. You and your Ringworld's forces are all going to die on this world.
units.displayText: We meet at last, Jiutian's Administrator. You and your Ringworld's forces are all going to die on this world.

spans.text: We meet at last, Jiutian's Administrator. You and your Ringworld's forces are all going to die on this world.

units.rawText: The Entropic leader...
units.displayText: The Entropic leader...

spans.text: The Entropic leader...

units.rawText: Caina raises her great sword high as she stands tall on Titan. Its outer crust slowly disintegrates and more Entropics emerge from between the pieces of rubble.
units.displayText: Caina raises her great sword high as she stands tall on Titan. Its outer crust slowly disintegrates and more Entropics emerge from between the pieces of rubble.

spans.text: Caina raises her great sword high as she stands tall on Titan. Its outer crust slowly disintegrates and more Entropics emerge from between the pieces of rubble.

units.rawText: Mwahahaha, it feels great to no longer have to maintain the comet's shape and freely assimilate a planet!
units.displayText: Mwahahaha, it feels great to no longer have to maintain the comet's shape and freely assimilate a planet!

spans.text: Mwahahaha, it feels great to no longer have to maintain the comet's shape and freely assimilate a planet!

units.rawText: Xuannu, Titan...
units.displayText: Xuannu, Titan...

spans.text: Xuannu, Titan...

units.rawText: Yes, its mass is decreasing... and the number of Entropics is increasing.
units.displayText: Yes, its mass is decreasing... and the number of Entropics is increasing.

spans.text: Yes, its mass is decreasing... and the number of Entropics is increasing.

units.rawText: Disengage all weapons systems limiters and fire at will. Yuwang, I'm leaving overall command to you for now.
units.displayText: Disengage all weapons systems limiters and fire at will. Yuwang, I'm leaving overall command to you for now.

spans.text: Disengage all weapons systems limiters and fire at will. Yuwang, I'm leaving overall command to you for now.

units.rawText: ...Stay safe. I'll buy you time.
units.displayText: ...Stay safe. I'll buy you time.

spans.text: ...Stay safe. I'll buy you time.

units.rawText: All units, Yuwang has command. Area A Teams 01 and 02, come with me; we're launching a decapitation strike.
units.displayText: All units, Yuwang has command. Area A Teams 01 and 02, come with me; we're launching a decapitation strike.

spans.text: All units, Yuwang has command. Area A Teams 01 and 02, come with me; we're launching a decapitation strike.

units.rawText: Xuannu slowly eases her control stick forward. The exo-armor launches from the ship's catapult and slams down in front of Caina.
units.displayText: Xuannu slowly eases her control stick forward. The exo-armor launches from the ship's catapult and slams down in front of Caina.

spans.text: Xuannu slowly eases her control stick forward. The exo-armor launches from the ship's catapult and slams down in front of Caina.

units.rawText: <size=40>Boom!</size>
units.displayText: Boom!

spans.text: Boom!

units.rawText: Plasma field generated. Igniting plasma beam saber.
units.displayText: Plasma field generated. Igniting plasma beam saber.

spans.text: Plasma field generated. Igniting plasma beam saber.

units.rawText: Hahahahahaha— Come on! Let's kill each other!
units.displayText: Hahahahahaha— Come on! Let's kill each other!

spans.text: Hahahahahaha— Come on! Let's kill each other!

units.rawText: All units, open fire.
units.displayText: All units, open fire.

spans.text: All units, open fire.

units.rawText: Gwaargh!
units.displayText: Gwaargh!

spans.text: Gwaargh!

units.rawText: Xuannu's support teams control their fire and their fiery barrage sends Caina flying.
units.displayText: Xuannu's support teams control their fire and their fiery barrage sends Caina flying.

spans.text: Xuannu's support teams control their fire and their fiery barrage sends Caina flying.

units.rawText: Target struck. Target has sustained damage.
units.displayText: Target struck. Target has sustained damage.

spans.text: Target struck. Target has sustained damage.

units.rawText: Team 01, recharge weapons. Team 02, fire!
units.displayText: Team 01, recharge weapons. Team 02, fire!

spans.text: Team 01, recharge weapons. Team 02, fire!

units.rawText: Xuannu wastes no time ramming Caina with her exo. The massive impact throws Caina off-balance for a moment.
units.displayText: Xuannu wastes no time ramming Caina with her exo. The massive impact throws Caina off-balance for a moment.

spans.text: Xuannu wastes no time ramming Caina with her exo. The massive impact throws Caina off-balance for a moment.

units.rawText: And this moment is the perfect opportunity for the agents to bombard her.
units.displayText: And this moment is the perfect opportunity for the agents to bombard her.

spans.text: And this moment is the perfect opportunity for the agents to bombard her.

units.rawText: Abbahhh!
units.displayText: Abbahhh!

spans.text: Abbahhh!

units.rawText: Caina grabs her chest and staggers back by several steps. While she's off-balance, a concentrated barrage of fire slams into her again.
units.displayText: Caina grabs her chest and staggers back by several steps. While she's off-balance, a concentrated barrage of fire slams into her again.

spans.text: Caina grabs her chest and staggers back by several steps. While she's off-balance, a concentrated barrage of fire slams into her again.

units.rawText: Ugh... Why, why you!
units.displayText: Ugh... Why, why you!

spans.text: Ugh... Why, why you!

units.rawText: Team 01, reload. Team 02, commence rotating volley fire.
units.displayText: Team 01, reload. Team 02, commence rotating volley fire.

spans.text: Team 01, reload. Team 02, commence rotating volley fire.

units.rawText: God dammit, you think you can beat me with this makeshift tin can?!
units.displayText: God dammit, you think you can beat me with this makeshift tin can?!

spans.text: God dammit, you think you can beat me with this makeshift tin can?!

units.rawText: Caina transforms her right hand into a tentacle and hurls a huge rock at unnatural speeds, aiming to smash the mid-air agents firing at her.
units.displayText: Caina transforms her right hand into a tentacle and hurls a huge rock at unnatural speeds, aiming to smash the mid-air agents firing at her.

spans.text: Caina transforms her right hand into a tentacle and hurls a huge rock at unnatural speeds, aiming to smash the mid-air agents firing at her.

units.rawText: Then, she raises her sword high, gathering chunks of Titan's crust around her body.
units.displayText: Then, she raises her sword high, gathering chunks of Titan's crust around her body.

spans.text: Then, she raises her sword high, gathering chunks of Titan's crust around her body.

units.rawText: <size=40>Let's see whether I rip all your teammates apart or if I cut you in half first!</size>
units.displayText: Let's see whether I rip all your teammates apart or if I cut you in half first!

spans.text: Let's see whether I rip all your teammates apart or if I cut you in half first!
